notes: Wording only: the app no longer tells you to turn the camera's WiFi on through Connect Device, GoPro App, which parks the camera on a pairing screen where it cannot record. Use Preferences, Connections, Wireless Connections: On (once, it stays on, no GoPro app needed), find the name and password under Camera Info, and press Mode back to the shooting screen. Force-stop Quik before using FlightPath; the two cannot share the camera.
